name: Machine Inner Chest Press
nameDa: Brystpres med samlende greb i maskine
grip: Neutral or narrow overhand grip on inner converging machine handles.
description: Press seated machine handles forward along a converging path using an inner neutral or narrow grip, creating peak horizontal adduction tension across the inner sternal pectorals at lockout.
setup: Adjust the seat height so the inner handles align with mid-chest level.
Sit upright with hips, upper back, and head firmly against the vertical back pad, feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the inner/neutral handles with elbows tucked comfortably at ~45 degrees to the torso.
instructions: Press the handles smoothly forward away from your chest along the machine's converging track.
Extend your arms fully, bringing your hands closer together in front of the center chest without locking out elbows aggressively.
Squeeze your pectorals forcefully at the peak contraction.
Return the handles slowly under complete control until hands are back beside the chest, feeling a comfortable chest stretch before the next rep.
cues: Press forward and squeeze hands together in the center.
Keep upper back and head against the backrest.
Control the stretch on the return.
commonMistakes: Allowing shoulders to roll forward off the backrest at peak extension.
Flaring elbows high and wide, shifting load away from the chest to anterior shoulders.
Bouncing weight plates off the stack stops between repetitions.
